newsitem.title: CHINA: China aims to boost sales-output ratio to 96.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: China aims to boost sales-output ratio to 96.3 pct.

text.p: China's Economic and Trade Commission has set a sales-to-production ratio goal of 96.3 percent for industrial enterprises in 1997, the Economic Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.

The accumulated sales to production ratio for industrial enterprises reached 95.86 percent at end-1996, with 97.17 percent for state-owned industry, 94.13 percent for collectives and 95.19 percent for private industries, it said.
China's lumbering state enterprises are struggling to tune output to the marketplace.
